titleEn: Maximum Consecutive Floors Without Special Floors
title: 不含特殊楼层的最大连续楼层数
summary: 在 bottom 到 top 闭区间内给定特殊楼层，求最长连续非特殊楼层数量。
insight: 排序特殊楼层；候选空档是 bottom 到首特殊前、相邻特殊之间、末特殊后到 top，分别计算长度取最大。
pitfalls: 边界楼层可能是特殊楼层
相邻特殊楼层间空档长度差一

solutions.title: 排序特殊楼层空档
solutions.idea: 枚举所有特殊点切出的非特殊连续区间。

code.java: class Solution { public int maxConsecutive(int bottom,int top,int[] special){Arrays.sort(special);int answer=special[0]-bottom;for(int i=1;i<special.length;i++)answer=Math.max(answer,special[i]-special[i-1]-1);return Math.max(answer,top-special[special.length-1]);} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun maxConsecutive(bottom:Int,top:Int,special:IntArray):Int{special.sort();var answer=special[0]-bottom;for(i in 1 until special.size)answer=maxOf(answer,special[i]-special[i-1]-1);return maxOf(answer,top-special.last())} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int maxConsecutive(int bottom,int top,vector<int>& special){sort(special.begin(),special.end());int answer=special[0]-bottom;for(int i=1;i<(int)special.size();++i)answer=max(answer,special[i]-special[i-1]-1);return max(answer,top-special.back());} };
